evals.prompt: I've attached the Hebrew Wikipedia article HTML for "The Beast" (the US presidential car). Please extract the plain Hebrew text into a CSV file with one row per sentence. Avoid sentences with mixed Hebrew and English. Strip all markup.
evals.expected_output: A CSV with a header row and one Hebrew sentence per row, covering the article's body paragraphs (from the current model through the presidential motorcade section). No HTML tags, no footnote markers like [1], no sentences mixing Hebrew and English (e.g. no rows containing 'Cadillac' or model names spelled in Latin letters), and no See-also/External-links/Footnotes list entries.
expectations: Output is a CSV file with a header row
Row count is roughly 85-105 sentences (matches the validated reference extraction of 96)
No row contains any Latin letters (A-Z or a-z)
No row contains HTML tags or entities like   or <a>
No row contains a bracketed footnote marker like [1]
No row is a See-also/External-links/Footnotes citation title (e.g. nothing referencing 'וואלה' or 'מאקו' as a source line)
Sentence 'הרכב הנוכחי נושא לוחית רישוי של וושינגטון די. סי.' appears as a single row (not split after 'די.')
A sentence ending in a gershayim measurement abbreviation like 'ס"מ.' or 'ק"ג.' correctly ends its row rather than being merged with the next sentence

evals.prompt: Here's a Hebrew news article saved as HTML (not Wikipedia). Extract the Hebrew sentences into a CSV, one sentence per row, and drop any sentence that mixes Hebrew and English.
evals.expected_output: A CSV with one row per sentence from the article body only (not the nav bar, related-articles sidebar, or footer copyright line). Sentences mentioning 'Tesla Model 3' or 'BYD Atto 3' in Latin letters are dropped entirely. The sentence with 'ק. אברהם' (a name with a middle initial) stays as one row instead of being split after 'ק.'. Sentences ending in gershayim abbreviations like ס"מ or ק"ג end correctly instead of merging with the next sentence.
expectations: Output is a CSV file with a header row
Row count is between 10 and 14 sentences
No row contains any Latin letters (A-Z or a-z)
No row mentions the nav bar text 'דף הבית' or the footer copyright text 'כל הזכויות שמורות'
No row is one of the related-articles sidebar titles ('מדריך לרכישת רכב חשמלי' or 'השוואת מחירים בין דגמים')
The sentence containing 'ק. אברהם' appears as a single row rather than split into two
A sentence ending in a gershayim abbreviation like ס"מ. or ק"ג. ends correctly as its own row
